jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description: Our mission We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How you'll help us achieve it We are growing our product design team and looking for an experienced mobile designer to expand features on our Android and iOS apps. You will have the opportunity to make financial services more accessible and inclusive for millions of people through working with thoughtful product managers, researchers, and engineers! In this role, you'll: Work closely with product managers, user researchers, engineers, and data analysts from the start to end of a feature. Create high quality designs, interactions, and prototypes to explore ideas in service of the best solution for the project (Wave uses Figma). Craft user research plans and work directly with our user researchers to identify problems and validate solutions in user testing. Contribute to Wave's design system and component library. jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous? Artefact est une nouvelle génération de société spécialisée dans le conseil en data et en marketing digital data-driven, dont les 2500 employés répartis sur 27 pays ont pour mission de transformer les données de nos clients en impact business tangible. La société est née en France en 2014 et à connu une croissance forte, sur son métier historique, le conseil data marketing, mais aussi progressivement sur tous les cas d’usages data appliqués à l’entreprise. Artefact est soutenu par des investisseurs de premier plan (Cinven), européens, et qui visent à bâtir un leader mondial dans son secteur. Le département Digital & Data Marketing d’Artefact  Au sein des bureaux parisiens, l’équipe Digital & Data Marketing d’Artefact France est composée de 65 consultants dont le rôle est de construire les stratégies digital marketing les plus adaptées aux enjeux de nos clients, de les déployer et d’en mesurer la performance.  En fonction des besoins des clients, nous aurons un rôle de conseil (stratégie, diagnostic de performance, modèle opérationnel, feuille de route, …) et/ou un rôle de mise en oeuvre avec les opérations de campagne et le déploiement de mesure du ROI (attribution/incrémentalité/MMM) Ces projets s’appuient sur une expertise complète des canaux marketing et des plateformes en Paid Social, Paid Search, Programmatique, Retail media, mais aussi sur une expertise avancée et en plein développement du GEO. jobs.title: Director, Clinical Research- Benign Hematology
jobs.description: Overview   Alnylam Pharmaceuticals is seeking an imaginative physician drug developer, with the flexibility and confidence to work across diseases within the neurology and hematology therapeutic area.  This role includes the opportunity to provide clinical leadership in developing RNAi therapeutics in Alnylam’s expanding portfolio, which spans from rare genetic to common diseases.   The successful candidate’s primary role will be one of the clinical study leads working on the plasminogen program transitioning from Phase 2 to Phase 3. The Director will report directly into the program clinical development strategy lead who provides the clinical research oversight of the program. The Director is expected to play a leading and influencing role in the overall clinical development strategies and drive progress and operational excellence of his/her clinical trial(s). This work will also involve extensive consultation and collaboration with external experts. The Director, Clinical Research, will work in a matrix organization across Regulatory, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, Preclinical, Commercial & Quality Assurance teams to ensure fully harmonized and integrated development strategies. The Director will be a key Alnylam Development spokesperson at external meetings, including regulatory interactions and scientific meetings.   Key Responsibilities   Be a subject matter expert for the relevant disease area(s) Be the strategic leader providing a strong, clear voice for the clinical program Develop creative but realistic approaches to drug development and lead clinical efforts towards global regulatory approvals Oversight of trial conduct and safety Collaborate closely with Preclinical, Regulatory Affairs and Medical Affairs to ensure tight strategic integration of product development plans. If you re ready to help the world s best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us! Are you an exceptional sales leader ready for an unparalleled challenge? We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Sales Manager to pioneer and grow our Enterprise Sales organisation for the Northern European market, based out of UK. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar. jobs.title: Territory Account Executive, Manchester
jobs.description: Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together. So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same. The Role Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional  Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square’s mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most. This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

Samen met je team zorg je voor betrouwbare, veilige en klant- en businessgerichte Technology-dienstverlening. We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface. We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale. Where does this role fit in? A2 (Automation & AI) is UpGuard's central team for getting value out of AI and automation. We discover how work actually happens across the business, build the automations and AI tools that make it faster, and help every team run them on their own. Demand is growing faster than the team, so we need an AI & Automation Analyst to help us keep up. As an AI & Automation Analyst, you'll be a business analyst first, with a hands-on streak. Working day to day with our lead analyst, you'll map how other teams really work, rethink those processes for the era of AI, and turn that into clear requirements. Our engineers handle the complex builds; you'll take the quick, simple ones off their plate. You'll also reshape how A2 itself works, starting with the team's AI harness: the shared context, Skills, connectors and light automations that let the team work in new ways, not just faster ones. Fresh Prints is a New York-based, fast-growing, fully remote, 150-person company with most of our team based in India and the Philippines. A few years ago, Fresh Prints began helping other fast-growing companies build their teams. We got so good at it that we spun out a new company to focus exclusively on that — and called it Frontier . At Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people and place them into the best companies. In three years, we’ve never lost a client. If you’re interested in a Frontier role and you apply and are accepted, we’ll screen you through a couple of internal interviews and aim to get you an interview for a full-time job within the month. Think of us as your personal talent agent — and good luck with the application! About Intelligems There are millions of e-commerce businesses around the world, and the industry is growing every year. Yet achieving profitability has never been harder. Most brands make guesses when it comes to pricing, discounts, shipping fees, and content — leaving 6–10% of potential profit on the table. Intelligems is a profit optimization platform that helps these businesses succeed. We provide merchants with A/B testing and personalization tools that help them run experiments, understand their data, and price dynamically — tools that were previously only available to companies like Amazon and Uber. We're currently working with 500+ brands and have processed over $4B of data. Backed by Matchstick Ventures, Vinyl Capital, Techstars, and founders from Klaviyo, Postscript, and Stedi, Intelligems has raised over $4M in funding . Our team is high-performing, low-ego, and extremely collaborative — and we’re excited to scale with top talent. Responsibilities: Provision and configure Amazon MSK clusters, Kafka topics, and schema registry . Configure and maintain Kafka Connect and CDC source connectors . jobs.title: Werkstudent:in Social Media (m/w/d)
jobs.description: ÜBER UNS HR Weekly ist der Video-Podcast für alle, die im Job und als Mensch wachsen wollen. Jede Woche spricht unsere Gründerin und Host Katharina mit Gäst:innen über Karriere, Leadership und Selbstmanagement. Wir gehören zu beyobie in Berlin. Du schneidest lieber zehn Reels und testest, was am besten performt, als an einem einzigen zu feilen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig. In dieser Rolle machst du aus unseren Folgen Reels, TikToks und YouTube Shorts. So entdecken neue Menschen unseren Podcast. Ehrlich gesagt: Das ist ein Job mit hohem Takt und viel Routine. Dafür wird dein Gespür für Hooks und Schnitt jeden Tag schärfer. DEINE AUFGABEN Du schneidest aus unseren Podcast-Folgen Reels, TikToks und YouTube Shorts. Du testest neue Reels auf Instagram und wertest aus, was ankommt. Du bringst die stärksten Clips auf alle Kanäle. Du baust unseren TikTok-Account von null auf. Du schickst uns einmal pro Woche ein kurzes Update, was gut lief. So startest du: Woche 1: Du gehst mit uns eine ganze Folge durch, lernst die Tools kennen und postest erste Test-Reels. Ab Monat 1: Du schneidest und postest eigenständig. Danach: Du startest unseren TikTok-Account. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Du schneidest Short-Form sicher, am Handy oder am Desktop. Du bist selbst viel auf Instagram, TikTok und YouTube Shorts unterwegs. Du spürst, was in den ersten zwei Sekunden zieht. Du schaust gern auf Zahlen und lernst daraus. Du arbeitest gern in Routinen und hältst deinen Takt selbst. Du sprichst und schreibst sehr gut Deutsch, auch in Untertiteln. Pluspunkte, kein Muss: Erfahrung mit Opus Clip, Edits, CapCut oder Premiere Du hast schon einen Account aufgebaut oder betreut, gern auch privat. Routine mit ChatGPT oder ähnlichen Tools Interesse an Arbeitswelt, Karriere und Persönlichkeitsentwicklung Bewirb dich auch, wenn du nicht alles mitbringst. Die Tools lernst du bei uns in einer Woche. DAS BIETEN WIR DIR Eigene Verantwortung für Reels, Shorts und den TikTok-Start Deine eigenen Zahlen: Du siehst sofort

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer (London)
jobs.description: About Edra Edra is solving one of the hardest problems in enterprise AI: AI models are generic but company processes are specific. We build AI agents that learn how processes actually run, and then run their operations. We're a Series A startup, backed by Sequoia and other leading VC firms, led by Co-Founders who created and led Forward Deployed AI Engineering at Palantir, and we're growing our team in New York and London. We're a deeply technical team of engineers, AI researchers, and strategists with a high bar for talent and a shared belief that exceptional people are the foundation of everything great we'll build. The Role We're building a learning system that teaches AI agents how enterprises actually work. Our system starts from what a customer already has: knowledge base articles, support conversations, tickets, system logs, and agent traces. From that evidence it reverse-engineers how the business actually runs and writes the process down as instructions a person can inspect and an agent can execute, with confidence scoring to know when to automate and when to seek human input. We're looking for AI Research Engineers who have built complex, production LLM-based systems. Whether you've scaled LLM workflows handling millions of requests, built multi-agent systems in production, or designed evaluation frameworks for enterprise deployments, we want people who bring intensity and self-direction to their craft. You'll work on our agentic learning environment: the loops that turn human corrections and agent outcomes into better knowledge and instructions over time. The job combines applied research with ownership of production systems. You find a failure, form a hypothesis, run the experiment, and ship the fix into real customer workflows. You'll spend most of your time advancing our core context-learning library and the harness that powers our agents across every customer. The work spans continuous learning, context engineering, agent orchestration, and evaluation

jobs.description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Von hier aus erfolgt das Management der größeren Forschungsschiffe und -plattformen „Polarstern“ und „Neumayer-Station III“, aber auch der kleineren Forschungsschiffe „Uthörn“, „Mya II“, „Coriolis“ , „Aade“, sowie der Forschungsyacht „Eugen Seibold“. Werde Teil einer außergewöhnlichen Crew! Du willst Technik mit Abenteuer verbinden und Teil einer einzigartigen Mission sein? Dann komm an Bord der POLARSTERN – dem Forschungsschiff des Alfred-Wegener-Instituts (AWI) – und begleite uns in die Arktis und Antarktis! Unser Auftraggeber ist ein etabliertes, regional stark verwurzeltes mittelständisches Finanzinstitut mit hoher gesellschaftlicher Verantwortung und einer engen Verbindung zu den Menschen und Unternehmen in der Oberpfalz. Als bedeutender Finanzdienstleister engagiert sich das Unternehmen nicht nur für seine Kundinnen und Kunden, sondern auch für das gesellschaftliche, kulturelle und sportliche Leben vor Ort. Im Zuge einer strategischen Weiterentwicklung soll insbesondere die Kommunikation moderner, digitaler und zielgruppenorientierter aufgestellt werden. Dafür suchen wir eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit, die klassische Öffentlichkeitsarbeit mit zeitgemäßer Kommunikation verbindet und neue Impulse setzt. Die Stelle: In dieser verantwortungsvollen Position übernimmst Du die Leitung des Bereichs Öffentlichkeitsarbeit und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Deinem Team die interne und externe Kommunikation strategisch weiter. Strategische Kommunikation: Du entwickelst die Kommunikationsstrategie kontinuierlich weiter und sorgst dafür, dass die Maßnahmen auf die übergeordneten Unternehmens- und Geschäftsziele einzahlen. Vorstandskommunikation: Du berätst den Vorstand bei kommunikativen Fragestellungen, bewertest Themen und Botschaften und entwickelst passende Kommunikationsansätze. jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Market Planning
jobs.description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. At Wolt, keeping courier supply healthy across every city we operate in is core to a great experience for both customers and couriers. As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning & managing supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once, from our largest metros to our smallest cities. That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll make sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets, and you'll help us learn which levers actually work. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations. It's for someone who is as comfortable designing a test or building a model as they are working out why a specific market is off plan and what to do about it. You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team and will partner closely with local operations and courier marketing so that our planning always reflects the reality on the ground. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Compute Libraries
jobs.description: About the job As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll develop, maintain and release the C++ libraries and runtime APIs that engineers use to build and execute workloads on Graphcore’s AI hardware. Your work will focus on developer-facing libraries, runtime components or a combination of both. You’ll design clear abstractions for low-level hardware capabilities, improve reliability and performance, and support developers integrating these libraries into the wider software stack. You will take ownership of library changes from design and implementation through review, integration, release and ongoing maintenance. Deliver dependable library releases through packaging, dependency validation, release notes and the maintenance fixes developers need. You’ll write API documentation, usage examples and migration guidance to help developers adopt changes confidently. Work with library users across the software stack to understand requirements, resolve integration issues and guide API improvements. The team and culture The AI Compute Libraries team develops high-performance compute libraries and the software infrastructure that helps engineers make effective use of Graphcore’s AI hardware. You’ll work alongside specialists in accelerator software, runtime systems and performance engineering. Together, you’ll turn hardware capabilities and developer requirements into practical, well-tested APIs, with clear documentation and dependable releases. What we’re looking for Essential skills: Strong modern C++ skills and a commitment to producing reliable, maintainable code. The ability to turn complex, low-level concepts into clear APIs and abstractions. Strong debugging and automated testing skills, including diagnosing issues in existing codebases. Confidence owning substantial engineering tasks independently and working effectively across teams. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats. Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific. At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It s a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately. Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific. jobs.title: GTM Lead Germany
jobs.description: At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients. We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started. The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it ! Context Germany is one of Europe's largest healthcare markets, and its hospitals face the same pressure we solve in France: rising administrative load, staff shortages and revenue lost to incomplete coding. As Germany GTM Lead, you are our first hire in the country. You will report directly to Paul Lafforgue, CEO and co-founder, and work closely with Chris, our CTO, and the product team in Paris. You will own everything from the first prospecting call to the first signed contracts, shape the local product and build the German team from zero. Location: 2 to 3 months of onboarding in Paris, then based in Germany with regular trips to Paris. Office in Munich or Berlin. Team: none at first. Around 5 people in H1 2027, around 12 by the end of 2027. Your mission Take Parallel from zero to a validated, repeatable market in Germany by the end of 2027: 2 to 3 flagship hospitals as paying customers, 2M€ ARR and a local team of around 15. jobs.title: Instrumentation Development Embedded Engineer
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT As the Instrumentation Development Embedded Engineer, you will own the development of high-speed control and protection systems for the Alpha fusion demonstrator, focusing on FPGA-based solutions for plasma heating hardware protection. You will work across the full development lifecycle, from writing and verifying HDL code to developing software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop testing, integrating embedded software and electronics, and establishing robust development and deployment pipelines. Für Installationsbetriebe heißt das drei bis vier Stunden pro Anlage , in denen ein Handwerker Formulare ausfüllt statt zu bauen. Wir lösen das mit Software. Unter unseren Kunden sind die größten Player der Solar- und Wärmepumpenbranche in Europa. Und weil dieses Problem den Installationsbetrieben so weh tut, konnten wir im letzten Jahr von null auf über 1 Mio. € Umsatz gewachsen - bootstrapped, profitabel und ohne Investorengeld. Deine Rolle Du arbeitest im operativen Kern unseres Produkts und trägst Ownership für einen ganzen Bereich . Dan is deze meeloopstage iets voor jou! Voor ons Cash Control team in Rotterdam zoeken we een stagiair(e) die meedraait in het dagelijkse cashmanagement. Je helpt bij het tijdig toewijzen van betalingen, het verwerken van bankafschriften en het bewaken van openstaande posten. Je werkt nauw samen met Credit Control, Invoicing en Accounts Payable en doet zo praktijkervaring op met cash application, reconciliaties en werken in ERP-systeem Exact. Waar ga je werken? Royal Den Hartogh Logistics is een internationale, toonaangevende logistiek dienstverlener voor de chemische, gas-, polymeer- en voedingsmiddelenindustrie. Ons familiebedrijf bestaat al sinds 1920 en heeft veiligheid en duurzaamheid stevig in het DNA verankerd. Met 54 locaties in 27 landen en ruim 2.600 collega's wereldwijd werken we continu aan slimme, toekomstbestendige logistieke oplossingen. Ons finance team in Nederland telt 20 collega's, verdeeld over onder andere Credit Control, Invoicing, Accounts Payable en Cash Control – en daar kom jij als stagiair(e) terecht. Wat ga je doen? Je bewaakt de dagelijkse Unallocated Cash : je houdt het overzicht bij, volgt openstaande posten op en rapporteert de belangrijkste KPI's. Je zoekt niet-herkende ontvangsten en niet-gematchte betalingen uit en helpt ze oplossen. Je boekt en verwerkt dagelijks bankafschriften in Exact, voor meerdere bankrekeningen en entiteiten (inkomend en uitgaand). Je matcht klantontvangsten en leveranciersbetalingen aan de juiste facturen. Je helpt bij bankreconciliaties en spoort verschillen op tussen bankafschriften en de administratie. Je denkt mee over verbeteringen om het toewijzen en afletteren efficiënter te maken. De ideale kandidaat Je volgt een mbo4- of hbo-opleiding in een financiële richting, zoals Finance & Control, Bedrijfsadministratie, Bedrijfseconomie

jobs.description: Gestalte die nächste Generation der Personaleinsatzplanung. Wir von der IT Studio Rech GmbH suchen für unseren Kunden und Partner, die MEP24 Software GmbH , einen Senior Full-Stack Developer in Vollzeit. MEP24 entwickelt Software, mit der Unternehmen ihre Mitarbeitenden passend einsetzen und ihren Arbeitsalltag besser organisieren. Seit 1996 bringt das Unternehmen Erfahrung aus der Personaleinsatzplanung mit. Heute vertrauen über 2.200 Kunden aus Apotheken, Kliniken und Handelsunternehmen auf MEP24. Mit mina.works entwickelt MEP24 seine neue SaaS-Plattform auf einem modernen TypeScript-Stack weiter. Dafür suchen wir Dich: jemanden, der Frontend und Backend beherrscht, Architektur mitgestalten möchte und Verantwortung für durchdachte Software übernimmt. Du wirst Teil des Entwicklungsteams von MEP24 – wir begleiten die Suche und das Kennenlernen. Aufgaben Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produktmanagement und Jens Gerstenecker, dem Geschäftsführer von MEP24, zusammen. Das Entwicklungsteam wächst – und Du gestaltest mit, wie Ihr zusammenarbeitet, technische Entscheidungen trefft und die Plattform weiterentwickelt. Als Entwickler wirst Du… Du entwickelst mina.works mit TypeScript, Node.js und React weiter – vom Backend bis zur Benutzeroberfläche. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für technische Entscheidungen und entwickelst die Architektur der Plattform gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter. Du arbeitest an verteilten Services und eventgetriebenen Abläufen mit Event Sourcing, CQRS und RabbitMQ. Du entwickelst verständliche REST-APIs, arbeitest mit PostgreSQL und setzt Redis für Caching und Nachrichtenverarbeitung ein. Du setzt fachliche Anforderungen in gut nutzbare Funktionen um und behältst dabei Wartbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und das Zusammenspiel der Services im Blick. Du bringst Dich in den Aufbau des Entwicklungsteams ein und gestaltest Entwicklungsprozesse und Qualitätsstandards mit. Du entwickelst den Einsatz von AI-Driven Development im Team weiter und lernst im begleitenden Coaching

jobs.title: Investor in Residence
jobs.description: About the role You've built a company, run a team or invested for a few years, and you're between chapters. Maybe you've exited, left a role, or wound something down. You want time to work out what comes next without stepping out of the venture world while you do. We're offering a seat in our Berlin office for six to nine months. You'll work as part of the investment team on real deals and real portfolio problems, and you'll have room to explore your own next move, whether that's founding again, joining a startup or going deeper into investing. We invest in companies that electrify energy and buildings, automate construction and industry, and make infrastructure more resilient. jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description: Grosse Veränderungen beginnen mit Menschen, die mehr erreichen wollen. Wie kommen Mitarbeitende zur Arbeit? Warum stehen Firmenautos ungenutzt herum, während Parkplätze knapp sind? Und wie wird nachhaltige Mobilität zur attraktivsten Wahl? Bei Urban Connect machen wir aus diesen Herausforderungen konkrete Lösungen. Wir verbinden geteilte E-Bikes und Firmenautos, öffentliche Verkehrsmittel, Mobilitätsbudgets und digitales Parkplatzmanagement auf einer Plattform. Damit helfen wir Unternehmen, Kosten zu senken, Ressourcen besser zu nutzen und ihren Mitarbeitenden mehr Freiheit zu geben. Unternehmen wie Roche, Google, SWISS und Lonza setzen bereits auf uns. Unser Anspruch geht weiter: Wir wollen die Art verändern, wie Unternehmen Mobilität organisieren. Und wir bieten das Betriebssystem, das dies möglich macht. Um diese Vision zu verwirklichen, suchen wir eine neugierige, unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Energie und gutes Urteilsvermögen mitbringt und mit uns das Unternehmen und die Mobilitätsbranche voranbringen möchte. Deine Rolle: echte Verantwortung, spürbare Wirkung Du möchtest ein Unternehmen mitgestalten, anspruchsvolle Probleme lösen und sehen, was deine Arbeit bewirkt. Als Business Development Manager arbeitest du eng mit unserem Sales- und Account-Management-Team sowie mit Product, Technology und Operations zusammen. Du entwickelst aus Kundenbedürfnissen, Daten und Marktkenntnissen überzeugende Mobilitätslösungen und konkrete Wachstumschancen. Du verantwortest Projekte, bringst eigene Ideen ein und treibst ihre Umsetzung voran. Wir erwarten, dass du von Anfang an durchdachte Fragen stellst, erkennst, wo du einen Beitrag leisten kannst, und ins Handeln kommst. Dabei unterstützen dich Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die wollen, dass du erfolgreich bist. Was du bei uns bewegst Aus Daten Chancen machen: Du analysierst Nutzungs- und Marktdaten, etwa zur Auslastung von Fahrzeugen und Parkplätzen, und entwickelst daraus umsetzbare Empfe

jobs.title: Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau
jobs.description: Wil jij impact maken aan de voorkant van onze uitdagende bouwprojecten? Heb je ruime technische kennis. Heb jij affiniteit met planning en prijsvorming? Dan is dit jouw kans om als Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau het verschil te maken! Dit wordt jouw baan Je vertaalt als Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau ontwerpen in optimale en slimme bouwmethodieken. Met jouw technische inzicht, praktische aanpak en overtuigingskracht speel je een sleutelrol in onze tenders en in de voorbereiding van onze projecten. Je werkt op het bedrijfsbureau van Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed in Rotterdam en maakt onderdeel uit van een ervaren team, met veel vrijheid en ruimte voor initiatief. Jij bent vanaf het begin betrokken bij onze woningbouw- en utiliteitsprojecten. Samen met een team van ervaren collega’s werk je onder andere aan: · Het analyseren van constructies en bepalen van de meest optimale bouwmethodiek. · Het opstellen van de bouwtijdplanning (Asta Powerproject) · Het opstellen van de algemene bouwplaatskosten · Het ontwerpen van 3D-bouwplaatsinrichtingen (Revit) · Het afstemmen met de materieeldienst, leveranciers en onderaannemers. · Input leveren voor BLVC- en logistieke plannen. · Input leveren voor een onderbouwd plan van aanpak om tenders te winnen. jobs.title: Stage of Afstuderen: Optimalisatie van Machine-inspecties
jobs.description: Wat ga je doen? Binnen Customer Service voert Voortman periodieke machine-inspecties uit om de technische staat van machines te beoordelen en klanten te adviseren over onderhoud, reparaties en mogelijke verbeteringen. Deze inspecties vormen een belangrijke basis voor het verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid, prestaties en levensduur van machines. Het huidige inspectieproces is door de jaren heen organisch gegroeid. Hierdoor worden inspectievragen niet altijd op dezelfde manier geïnterpreteerd, verschillen beoordelingen tussen monteurs en worden bevindingen niet overal uniform vastgelegd. Ook de rapportage richting klanten kan op onderdelen duidelijker, consistenter en meer actiegericht worden ingericht. Tijdens deze opdracht analyseer je het volledige machine-inspectieproces en ontwikkel je een vernieuwde werkwijze die aansluit bij de huidige en toekomstige behoeften van onze serviceorganisatie. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar de inhoud van inspectievragen, maar ook naar de manier waarop inspecteurs informatie verzamelen, beoordelingen uitvoeren, bevindingen vastleggen en resultaten communiceren naar klanten. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het analyseren van het huidige machine-inspectieproces en het identificeren van verbeterpunten; Het ontwikkelen van een logische en uniforme structuur voor machine-inspecties; Het herformuleren en standaardiseren van bestaande inspectievragen; Het opstellen van duidelijke beoordelingscriteria voor de technische staat van machineonderdelen; Het ontwikkelen van een uniforme methode voor het vastleggen van metingen, bevindingen, foto's en aanbevolen acties; Het verbeteren van inspectierapportages zodat technische bevindingen overzichtelijk, eenduidig en actiegericht worden gepresenteerd; Het opstellen van een implementatievoorstel voor het vernieuwde inspectieproces binnen Customer Service. Het eindresultaat is een praktisch en onderbouwd verbeterplan waarmee Voortman machine-inspecties wereldwijd op een uniforme manier kan uitvoere

jobs.description: Wat ga je doen? Binnen Service & Support onderzoeken we hoe Augmented Reality (AR) kan bijdragen aan een efficiëntere en effectievere dienstverlening. Nieuwe technologieën bieden steeds meer mogelijkheden om klanten en monteurs op afstand te ondersteunen en stilstand van machines te beperken. Wij willen inzicht krijgen in welke toepassingen voor Voortman relevant zijn en hoe deze structureel ingezet kunnen worden binnen onze serviceorganisatie. Tijdens deze stage onderzoek je de technische en organisatorische mogelijkheden van Augmented Reality binnen service en remote support. Je analyseert verschillende toepassingsmogelijkheden, waaronder het gebruik van een RealWear Smart Glass voor ondersteuning op afstand. Daarnaast onderzoek je welke procesveranderingen nodig zijn om AR succesvol te implementeren en welke voordelen dit kan opleveren voor de kwaliteit, snelheid en efficiëntie van onze serviceprocessen. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Het onderzoeken van de mogelijkheden van Augmented Reality binnen customer service, remote support en field service; Het analyseren van de inzet van de RealWear Smart Glass voor het ondersteunen van monteurs en klanten op afstand; Het in kaart brengen van benodigde procesveranderingen voor de implementatie van Smart Glasses; Het bepalen van mogelijke procesverbeteringen op het gebied van efficiëntie, reactietijd en servicekwaliteit. Het eindresultaat van de opdracht is een onderbouwd implementatieplan waarmee Voortman de inzet van Augmented Reality binnen haar serviceorganisatie kan beoordelen en verder ontwikkelen. Wij vragen Een HBO- of WO-opleiding in de richting van Bedrijfskunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, Applicatie Technologie of vergelijkbaar. Wij bieden Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand; Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt; Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software; Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Index Intelligence
jobs.description: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked. We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves. Desired Experience You are comfortable owning a problem with no ground truth, where the first job is defining what the right answer means Hands-on ML experience with classifiers, rankers and calibration, plus strong data instincts at web scale You think in end-to-end impact. A signal only counts if a decision changes and search gets better You like working across teams. Crawling, indexing and retrieval all consume what you build You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world Example Projects Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it Tea

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Content Understanding
jobs.description: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. As a backend engineer, you'd play a critical role in our search architecture. We're pretty flexible on what projects people work on based on their skills and interests. Search quality is bounded by what we understand about a page. Before anything can be retrieved, something has to work out what the page actually says. That means parsing it into the parts that are content and the parts that are furniture, classifying what kind of page it is and what it is about, telling whether the page is usable at all, extracting when it was published, judging how good it is and whether it can be trusted, and working out whether it says anything that a page we already have does not. All of this has to work on every page on the web, in every language, in every shape the web comes in. Some of this is classic document understanding. Some of it is much more open. Credibility and misinformation, AI-generated and machine-spun content, and pages written to be found rather than read are all unsolved, and search results are only as trustworthy as our answers to them. We are looking for a research engineer to work on this. There is a lot of room to do it well. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine – Query Engine
jobs.description: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on. What you'll do Own storage and indexing across backends: data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down. Réglementée par l’ACPR et bénéficiant du passeport européen dans 29 pays, Lemonway est basée à Paris et Hambourg et rassemble 150 Lemonheroes multiculturels et engagés. Plus de 400 marketplaces nous font confiance. Nous gérons 1,4 million de portefeuilles utilisateurs et avons levé 50 M€ auprès de Breega, SpeedInvest et Toscafund. Rentable depuis quatre ans et en croissance de +25 % en 2025, Lemonway vise à rester parmi les leaders du paiement en Europe grâce à une croissance saine et durable. Secteur : FinTech / Paiements en ligne Localisation : Paris, France (Quartier du Sentier, 2e arrondissement) Télétravail : Jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine (au choix) Le poste Lemonway est à la recherche de son prochain Gestionnaire Cash Management en stage pour renforcer son équipe actuelle et accompagner sa croissance. Il s'agit d'une opportunité unique de rejoindre une fintech ambitieuse dans le secteur du paiement en constante évolution. Les principales responsabilités Au sein de l’équipe Cash Management et sous la supervision d’un Senior, tu interviendras sur plusieurs aspects du flux des paiements. Contribuer aux rapprochements bancaires et à la réconciliation des flux de paiement. Assurer le suivi des retours de fonds et des rejets de virements, identifier les anomalies et participer aux actions correctives. Apporter un support opérationnel dans la gestion des incidents liés aux flux de paiement. jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. jobs.title: Technical Customer Support
jobs.description: QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢. The Role We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality. You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to. Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are. The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking. This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup.
